mentions.name: MAXSTACK
mentions.description: A web framework for rapidly building SaaS apps with AI, aiming to enable 'fast-fashion SaaS'. It ships common SaaS features pre-built (CRUD, blog, auth), lets developers import framework templates until customization is needed, generates forms from a zod schema, and provides docs, TypeScript interfaces, a CLI for common tasks, and MCP support for AI agents.
mentions.problem: Building SaaS apps is slow and repetitive; the framework aims to make building them much faster and easier.
mentions.audience: Developers and founders building SaaS apps
mentions.source_excerpt: MAXSTACK: Web framework for rapidly building SaaS apps with AI - trying to enable the next wave of 'fast-fashion saas'. Think of it like better-auth is doing for auth, I want to do for the rest of SaaS
